versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00182 The RTE shall support the conversion between a texttable data representation (enu- meration) and a mixed linear scaled and texttable data representation. In this case only the enumeration part of the data representation shall be converted, the linear scaled part shall be handled as out of range data.
